title: Memory - Recover Lost Revival Architecture
description: A mod that aims to help other people reconstruct lost revival architecture. The first recreated house is the real house of the famous Bulgarian revolutioner Georgi Rakovski.
body:
#                                   **What is Memory?**
It starts as a project from a small group of students and their senior teacher of hisory and civilizations from Sofia VHSE "John Atanasoff" for The Second National Conference "Virtues of the soul and the will".
The theme is Rakovski, so we decided our first house, which is a structure in the game, to be Rakovski's lost house, where he has lived. The only sources we found for the real house was just one sketch, made by memories, in The National Library "Cyril and Methodius", which has a Bulgarian Historical Archive. 

![Fig. 1: Sketch of the original house of Georgi Rakovski made by Decho Iliev's memories](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b3e52fa0d776d8c781f89a682e61e21c7bde50ff.jpeg)
### Fig. 1: Sketch of the original house of Georgi Rakovski made by Decho Iliev's memories

So we made two remakes of the house - one in Blender and the other is this project.
